what: How each check name in the omnimarket task-class template becomes part of a delegate call's goal contract (delegation_step.py text). A name with no row refuses the call before any engine runs. treatment: item = an executable check (check_type and check_value) that becomes a contract item; gate_reject_only = the quality gate decides it, the receipt records it, it can refuse a call and never makes one DONE; skipped = executable in principle with no executor wired, recorded SKIPPED and not counted.

template.what: The template revision the every_template_name_mapped test reads. CI fetches exactly this commit's file; a local run reads it from the omnimarket clone with git show. Bump it with the rows when the template gains a name.
